title: Unvented roof space
jurisdiction: British Columbia (specific local authority not named in published decision)

facts.text: A new single-family dwelling has a roof deck over habitable space; two-pound spray foam is proposed between joists with no venting between insulation and roof sheathing.

The appellant said its submission contained a research report on mold in vented attics, ASHRAE handbook material, an Ontario Buildings Branch opinion, foam characteristics, an objectives analysis, air-permeability information, and history of unvented assemblies.
The building official sought scientific evidence and testing by an accredited agency, particularly for an uncontrolled on-site assembly.
